note: Can. 1365 punishes teaching a doctrine condemned by an ecumenical council. Dei Filius can. II.1 condemns the denial of natural knowability, so by the practice's own law teaching that denial is sanctioned. Gap: sanctioning the denial is excluding a move, not yet endorsing the defined move as correct; and sanctions are law, which the fideist may place outside grammar (STMT-COUNCIL-TEACHING-THEOLOGY-NOT-GRAMMAR).
